title: Big Bold Fruity Mango Passion 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Fruity Nic Salts Mango Passion brings together the rich, tropical sweetness of mango with the tangy, exotic flavour of passionfruit. This refreshing and vibrant e-liquid is perfect for vapers who enjoy exotic fruit-inspired blends, offering a delightfully fruity and satisfying vape experience. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Big Bold Nic Salts are designed for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for a fast, satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love this flavour, there are several other flavours to try from Big Bold’s collection, including Menthols, Creamy and Fruity flavours. Explore such beguiling blends as Honey Melon, Banana Milk, and Vanilla Custard for a Big Bold burst of flavour and a taste sensation like no other.
